title: Trump Orders US Aircraft Carriers to Go Back to Steam Catapults
title_cn: 特朗普命令美国航母恢复使用蒸汽弹射器
summary: President Donald Trump ordered the Navy to return to using steam catapults to launch planes off of aircraft carriers, acting on a longtime complaint despite opposition from many naval officers.

title: Burnham Faces Cost-of-Living Dilemma With Business Tax Shift
title_cn: 伯纳姆因营业税转移而面临生活成本困境
summary: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham faces a dilemma over how to cut the cost of living while rebalancing business taxes toward larger companies. Hitting some bigger firms might cause them to pass prices onto consumers.
